title: Specifications must transition through defined lifecycle states
description: Specs are created in an implicit draft state and never formally updated to reflect that they have been implemented and accepted. There is no way to distinguish a spec that has been run and merged from one that is pending, abandoned, or superseded by a newer spec for the same area. The README index shows all specs with no status differentiation.
proposed_resolution: Add a status field to spec frontmatter with defined values: draft | active | superseded. The run skill must transition the spec to active when its run is accepted (QA pass and PR merged). When a new spec targets the same area or file as an older spec, mark the older as superseded with a superseded_by field referencing the new spec slug. Update the README specification index to include a status column. The spec schema and schema validation file must be updated to declare the status field.
